newsitem.title: USA: Group names nominees to Mason-Dixon board.
newsitem.headline: Group names nominees to Mason-Dixon board.

text.p: A group urging Mason-Dixon Bancshares Inc to explore possibilities for a merger or consolidation said Friday it has proposed three nominees for election to the bank holding company's board at the annual meeting this year.
The nominees are Barbara Floyd, Leroy E. Kirby Jr. and Clarke Langrall, the group said in a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

The nominations were made on December 11 by Floyd, president of Anthony Investments, and two other investors, Charles Miller Jr. and Rudolp Linder. They made the nominations in their individual capacities, according to the filing.
Floyd is a former chief financial officer of Mason-Dixon, the Baltimore-based parent of Carroll County Bank and Trust Co of Maryland.
